# Orchard irrigation notes

Question: Which watering plan works for a small orchard with sandy soil?

Method A: one short morning drip cycle. It is easy to schedule but may miss deep roots.
Method B: two shorter cycles. Rejected for now because the second cycle needs a valve controller not available on site.

Source: [Valves overview](https://example.org/valves?version=2&mode=drip).
